problem: If $\,\text{Re}(x)=[\begin{aligned}a & b \\ c & d\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,\text{Im}(x)=[\begin{aligned}e & f \\ g & h\end{aligned}]\,$ are the real and imaginary parts of the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}2-3\text{i} & 1-\text{i} \\ 1+\text{i} & 5\text{i}\end{aligned}]\,$ then what is the value of $cd+gh?$

feedback.problem:
Given the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}1-\text{i} & -2 \\ -\text{i} & 5+\text{i}\end{aligned}]$, find the result of applying to $A$ the following elementary row operation:

$$
{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+\frac{\text{i}}{1-\text{i}}{R}_{1}
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Let's apply the row operations to $A:$

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}1-\text{i} & -2 \\ -\text{i} & 5+\text{i}\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+\frac{\text{i}}{1-\text{i}}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1-\text{i} & -2 \\ -\text{i}+\frac{\text{i}(1-\text{i})}{1-\text{i}} & 5+\text{i}-\frac{2\text{i}}{1-\text{i}}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1-\text{i} & -2 \\ -\text{i}+\text{i} & \frac{(5+\text{i})\cdot (1-\text{i})-2\text{i}}{1-\text{i}}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1-\text{i} & -2 \\ 0 & 6\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the result  is 

$$
[\begin{aligned}1-\text{i} & -2 \\ 0 & 6\end{aligned}].
$$
